title: Olive Oil Infused Italian Shrimp Pasta
description: A light and flavorful Italian dish featuring shrimp, garlic, and olive oil, served in scallop shells. This low-carb friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the zucchini noodles for 3-5 minutes or until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and add the minced garlic.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side or until pink and cooked through.
Add the cherry tomatoes to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the grated parmesan and cook until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
To serve, place a portion of the zucchini noodles in each scallop shell and top with the shrimp and tomato mixture.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
